main_text.l: Secundum alios illi, qui vxores neglectim
habet, perinde quasi eas statim essent amissu-
ri vel, qui non ponunt in re vxoria summam
felicitatem, adeo vt Dei obliuiscantur, & ab-
iiciant curam æternæ salutis: sed sciunt hæc
quoque rem, vt alias, non esse perpetuam,
sed temporaneam, & vna cum habitu mun-
di præterire.
Deniq; illi qui vxorores suas non amant
supra Christum, neque sinunt se ab illis in
profesione euangelij impediri, propter quod
etiam parati sunt illas, iuxta Christi regulá,
odisse, ac relinquere, si opus sit. Vt
vero & nos velimus ac valeamus Christi cau-
sa & euangelij, relinquere non solum vxores
& liberos, sed etiam parentes, fratres, sorores,
domos, aut agros & omnia, quo tandem et-
iam vitæ æternæ cum Apostolis electis ac san-
ctis (Matthæi 19. ) sortiamur hæreditatem,
largiatur nobis Deus pater spiritum sanctum
per Christum Iesum Dominum nostrum, Amen.
CONCIO LI.
1. Corinth. 7.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "vxorores" as printed; "benaū" at the line end is unclear and marked [?] in the text where it stands was not added, since the word cannot be read with certainty; "fortiamur" is printed with a long s that looks like f, read as sortiamur (sortiri, to obtain by lot), not certain. "Attamen" is preceded by a small brace-like mark in the scan, not transcribed. Bottom of the page carries no catchword or signature. Running head read as printed.
